note: Appendix Note 27, p. xl (wager of law; trial by inspection). Bl. Com., Grand Coustumier and Viner are not cases. Cross-checked with 1838 and 1835 records of the same footnote.

citations.raw: Vin. Ab. Trial, (B. 2), 10, cites 29 Ap. xxxvii. 19 (E. 2)
citations.note: year book cited through Vin. Ab. Trial (B. 2) 10, on trial by inspection of nonage; 29 Edw. III. 1843 prints '29 Ap. xxxvii.' as 1835 and 1838 do; the 1824, 1827 and 1831 editions print '29 Ass. 37', the Liber Assisarum, pl. 37, so page left out and the plea noted here. '19 (E. 2)' is Viner's further reference with no folio, not recorded. No source for the year books.
